verdict.rationale: The Washington Department of Revenue is a government tax and licensing agency whose My DOR portal handles filing, payment and licensing. It is not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a category error for this product type. Saving draft returns and amending filed returns are manual return-editing features, not versioned automations, and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
